## History

Born a [Methodist](../codex/factions.md#methodist), Davis converted to Presbyterianism at the insistence of his wife, a woman of the Douglas clan who kept him toeing the [Presbyterian](../codex/factions.md#presbyterian) mark throughout his life. After his death, a monument was erected sacred to his memory, though his wealthy and overbearing widow, Mrs. Alec Davis, continued to exert her influence in the community.
